title: Bullfrog
hook: Player-safe note: A bull-sized swamp frog with armored warts, a heavy throat pouch, amber watching eyes, and enough mass to make a muddy bank feel like a sprung trap.

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: Broad armored body, moss and river mud across the back, huge springing legs, amber eyes, and reed charms caught in the warts like old wetland warnings.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: A bull-sized swamp frog with armored warts, a heavy throat pouch, amber watching eyes, and enough mass to make a muddy bank feel like a sprung trap.; run Bullfrog with a motive, an exit route, and one visible sign of the system that produced the threat.

affordances: Ask Bullfrog what they need right now.
Watch what they protect before asking for trust.
